items.title: 67849_Leroy Elliot Stewart oral history interview
items.q: Big Sid Catlett, yes... Now, it was mentioned that you -- were you performing at the place the night that Big Sid Catlett died? Yes, I was.

ctx.x: Big Sid Catlett, yes, and another fellow who looks something like Jo . Forget his name. It'll come to me.
